lore.short_description: Rock gnomes are inventive and practical tinkerers, known for sharp intellect, sturdy resilience, and a natural talent for crafting clever mechanical devices.
lore.full_text: As a rock gnome, you have a natural inventiveness and hardiness beyond that of other gnomes. Most gnomes in the worlds of D&D are rock gnomes, including the tinker gnomes of the Dragonlance setting.
